{{Top|leg}}
'''Bellberries''' were a type of [[Berry/Legends|berries]] that grew on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. The [[Giantism|giant]] creature known as the [[Grudakk]] used to make a stew that contained bellberries, along with [[watermoss]], wild [[Lichen/Legends|lichen]], [[sprigmelon]]s, and [[Mushroom/Legends|mushrooms]].<ref name="teebo">''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]''</ref>
